_meta.what: the LIVE client wording of item-set bonus lines, as captured by the owner's screenshots of the 1.12 client (build 1.60.1.70862). The client renders set bonuses from the ItemSetSpell -> Spell pipeline, which no committed dump provides (wowf-ItemSet.json carries no spell/threshold columns), so the only honest source is the owner's own capture. en = the exact live line; fa = the meaning-first Persian (the digits stay Persian; tools/export_forever_addon.py templates them into {N} placeholders against the EN line's numbers). A threshold is listed only when the owner documented it.
